nameOrigin: the sound of a bell ringing

pokedexEntries.di: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

pokedexEntries.prl: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.

pokedexEntries.pt: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It emits high-frequency cries that  people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.
